faq.q: What is the origin of Aatikah?
faq.a: Aatikah is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of aatika.
Yes — the underlying form عاتكة is Arabic.
Aatikah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Aatikah, aatikah, atikah. Script forms are عاتكة, عاتکه, عاتکہ, आतिका.
